sentences.en: At night Juha went to the well.
He said: the moon has fallen inside.
He ran home and brought a rope.
He tied a heavy stone to the rope.
He threw it into the well.
He pulled with all his strength.
The stone was caught among stones.
Juha fell backwards on his back.
He lay on the ground and looked.
The moon was up in the sky.
He said: thanks be to God.
He said: I got it out in time.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: והגב שלי שילם על זה.
sentences.en: He said: and my back paid for it.
